records.public_safe_text: on august, 9,2019 at approximately 2148 hours, i, officer pacenda 307 of the brookshire police department was dispatched to interstate 10 [roadway]. and fm [roadway] rage incident where a man on a motorcycle got off and began jumping on a vehicle. the weather was clear and visibility was limited due to it being nighttime hours. at approximately 2149 hours, i arrived on location and observed a gray in color dodge van bearing texas license plate: kyl 6557 parked on the interstate 10 entrance ramp. a white male who i later identified as garrett, joseph allen (w/m dob: [date] al dl: 10041648) ran from the passenger side of the vehicle and approached me stating the van ran him over. i did not observe any visible injuries on garrett. i requested for waller county ems to make my location. garrett stated he was passing the intersection of ih 10 [roadway] and fm 1489 when he observed a van with their high beams on. garrett further stated that he stopped and dismounted [roadway] of traffic to attempt to tell the driver of the van that he could not see because the high beams were illuminated. as garrett was standing in the roadway, garrett stated the van ran over his foot. i identified the driver to be woods, dandra beatice (b/f dob: [date] tx id# 29283146) woods stated she was at the intersection of interstate 10 and fm 1489 east of the stop sign when she was attempting to switch lanes. woods further stated while attempting to merge the motorcycle made an attempt to not let her over. woods admitted that she honked her horn and did illuminate her high beams. as she was passing the intersection and entered the ih 10 entrance ramp, she observed a white male identified as garrett dismount [roadway] of traffic and ""flipped them off."" she further stated the began to run towards her vehicle. woods stated she was scared because she did not know if the male possessed a gun or a knife. in an attempt to avoid any confrontation, and scared for her life, she attempted to flee by driving around [roadway] around him , she unintentionally made contact with his foot with the vehicle. woods stated she pulled over and another passenger dialed 911. woods stated garrett ran over to the driver's side window, spat on her vehicle and waled away. waller county ems medic 5 arrived on location to access garrett's injuries. garrett refused ems. garret is at fault for dismounting [roadway] of traffic without cause. garrett was struck by the unit 1. garrett is at fault for being in the roadway that was not a crosswalk and without right of way. woods was issued citation # 157373 for no driver's license.

records.public_safe_text: police responded to the location for a report of a hit and run involving a pedestrian who was struck by a vehicle. i arrived on scene and found unit 2 lying [roadway]. unit 2 was already being treated by ems when i arrived, and appeared to be in severe pain. i spoke with w1 and w2 who observed the driver of unit 1 hit unit 2 while unit 1 was traveling north on perrin beitel. w3 and w4 advised that unit 1 made [roadway] and struck unit 2 while unit 2 was riding in his wheelchair on the right side of the roadway. the witnesses also advised that the driver of unit 1 stopped for a brief moment then drove off without providing any aid or information for unit 2. the driver of unit 1 was located at an alternate location during the investigation and spoke with officer t. thornburgh #0015 [medical facility] by ems on scene for severe pain to his left side, and i was informed by medical personnel at the location that unit 2's injuries did not appear to be life threatening. csi m. hurst #9430 photographed the scene and the damage to unit 1. det. g. m. villanueva #2580 with tid was notified and briefed on the details of the incident. coban/bwc video available.
